record_type_quote: The purpose of the present study was to replicate and extend those findings relating delay discounting and demand to cannabis use behaviors.

targets.authors: Aston ER, Metrik J, Amlung M, Kahler CW, MacKillop J.
targets.title: Interrelationships between marijuana demand and discounting of delayed rewards: Convergence in behavioral economic methods.
targets.evidence_quote: Relatively little research, however, has simultaneously evaluated demand and delay discounting metrics despite their mutual importance for this and other theoretical models. In fact, only one study has done so in the context of cannabis use ( Aston et al., 2016 ).
targets.outcome_quote: Despite these potential limitations, this study replicates and extends previous research uniquely relating delay discounting and behavioral economic demand variables with cannabis use.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly conclude that the replication succeeds overall.

reasoning: New online sample re-tests the unique cannabis use associations reported by Aston et al. (2016). Other literature comparisons and task validations do not establish additional specific replication targets.
